---
title: "Homework Assignments"
author: "Bill Perry"
title-block-banner: true
page-layout: full

format:
  html:
    toc: false
    downloads: []
    embed-resources: false
    self-contained: false

listing:
  contents: "hw_*/*.qmd"        # matches your hw_01, hw_03, ... folders
  type: table
  sort: "order asc"              # sorts by the `order:` field in each qmd
  sort-ui: false
  filter-ui: true
  categories: true
  fields: [order, week, title, description]
  field-display-names:
    order: "Homework #"
    week: "Week"
    title: "Homework"
    description: "Description"
---

Homework assignments are posted here, pulled straight from each file's
YAML frontmatter (`order:`, `week:`, `description:`). Click one to view
the details, due dates, and submission instructions.
